title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #18

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the duty of Raqib and Atid? (1 mark)
   A. To blow the Trumpet
   B. To take souls
   C. To bring rain
   D. To record our deeds

2. Which surah is the last surah of the Qur'an? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Falaq
   B. An-Naas
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. Al-Ikhlas

3. Which verse teaches that nothing is like Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 110:1
   B. Qur'an 42:11
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 1:1

4. Which prophet helped his father to build the Kaaba? (1 mark)
   A. Hud
   B. Yunus
   C. Ismail
   D. Idris

5. What should come before screen time? (1 mark)
   A. Games
   B. Nothing
   C. Videos
   D. Prayer, homework and helping at home

6. What can we learn from Ali about young people? (1 mark)
   A. Children are weak
   B. Even young people can accept truth and be brave
   C. Children cannot help
   D. Only adults matter

7. Which is an example of wasting food? (1 mark)
   A. Finishing your food
   B. Throwing away half a plate you took
   C. Taking a small portion
   D. Sharing leftovers with a neighbour

8. Which surah says "Say: He is Allah, the One"? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Masad
   B. An-Naas
   C. Al-Kafirun
   D. Al-Ikhlas

9. Which verse tells us to greet when entering homes? (1 mark)
   A. Qur'an 1:2
   B. Qur'an 24:61
   C. Qur'an 112:1
   D. Qur'an 110:1

10. What does the Qur'an (7:26) say is the best clothing? (1 mark)
   A. The clothing of righteousness
   B. The most expensive
   C. The newest
   D. The brightest

11. "Taahir" means (1 mark)
   A. Fasting
   B. Pure and clean
   C. Prayer
   D. Impure

12. What does the Qur'an (7:31) say about eating and drinking? (1 mark)
   A. Never eat sweets
   B. Eat as much as possible
   C. Eat and drink but do not waste
   D. Eat only at night

13. When you enter your home after school, what should you do first? (1 mark)
   A. Shout
   B. Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   C. Sleep
   D. Slam the door

14. In which city is the Kaaba? (1 mark)
   A. Nairobi
   B. Makkah
   C. Mombasa
   D. Madinah

15. Which body part is wiped, not washed? (1 mark)
   A. Head
   B. Hands
   C. Arms
   D. Face

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Name the five daily prayers in order and give the rak'ahs of any two. (3 marks)

17. Explain the role of Abu Bakr (R.A.) in the growth of Islam. (4 marks)

18. Explain the lesson from the story of the man who gave a dog water. (3 marks)

19. How can a child respond politely to a friend who laughs at their modest dress? (3 marks)

20. Give two items used in purification of najasaat. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — To record our deeds
   They write what a person says and does.

2. B — An-Naas
   An-Naas is number 114, the last surah.

3. B — Qur'an 42:11
   It says there is nothing like Him and He is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

4. C — Ismail
   Ismail and Ibrahim raised the foundations.

5. D — Prayer, homework and helping at home
   Priorities first.

6. B — Even young people can accept truth and be brave
   Ali was a boy.

7. B — Throwing away half a plate you took
   Taking more than you can eat causes waste.

8. D — Al-Ikhlas
   These are the first words of Al-Ikhlas.

9. B — Qur'an 24:61
   Surah An-Nur 24:61.

10. A — The clothing of righteousness
   Good character is best.

11. B — Pure and clean
   Taahir is the opposite of najis.

12. C — Eat and drink but do not waste
   Allah does not love those who waste.

13. B — Say Bismillah and the dua, then greet
   Say dua and greet.

14. B — Makkah
   The Kaaba is in Makkah.

15. A — Head
   The head is wiped.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Fajr (2), Dhuhr (4), Asr (4), Maghrib (3), Isha (4). Any two with correct rak'ahs.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for names in order and 2 marks for two rak'ahs.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: He believed at once, invited others, spent his wealth freeing believers, and was the Prophet's companion in the cave.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of four roles.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: A small act of kindness can earn Allah's forgiveness and reward, and there is reward in serving every living creature.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for forgiveness, 1 mark for all creatures.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Stay calm, explain that they dress that way because of their faith, and do not insult back.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for calm, 1 mark for explaining, 1 mark for not insulting.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Water, soil, soap, clean cloth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
